repeated exposure to sport video games can influence consumers' emotional and cognitive responses to sport brands, which in turn can affect brand attitude.
repeated exposure to sport video games elicits emotional reactions that are transferred to sport brand attitudes through sport video game attitudes.
emotional reactions and cognitive appraisals of sport brand exposure in sport video games are positively related to sport brand attitude formation.

the formation of brand attitude through emotional and cognitive responses to sport brands in SVG and how this process varies across different levels of brand familiarity.
the role of cognitive and emotional reactions in sport video gaming in the context of brand attitude formation.

the formation of brand attitudes in a unique virtual environment, which is not only important for marketers but also provides a platform for researchers to explore the role of emotions and cognitive responses in brand attitude formation.

the findings of the present study provide empirical evidence that sport consumers’ emotional and cognitive responses to repeated exposure of SVG elicit brand attitudes.

this study provides empirical evidence that the emotional and cognitive reactions of sport consumers toward SVG are transferred to the sport brand attitudes through the attitudes of sport video games.
this study provides empirical evidence that the emotional and cognitive responses to sport brand in SVG have a positive effect on brand attitude formation.

this research is a first attempt to explore how consumers form brand attitudes toward a brand in a virtual sport setting.
sport video game marketers should be cognizant of the role that emotional reactions to the game and its brands have on consumer attitudes.
the findings of this study can be applied to sport marketing and sport management in general.

the repetition of sport brands in SVG is an effective tool to form sport brand attitudes and the effectiveness of the repetition is moderated by the level of brand familiarity.
marketers should consider the role of emotional reactions to sport brands in virtual sport environments in their branding efforts.
marketers can use the virtual sport experience to elicit emotional reactions and cognitive appraisals about sport brands.
